subject: Quantum Field Theory including QED

entries.statement: For any compact simple gauge group G, construct a nontrivial quantum Yang–Mills theory on R^4 with a mass gap Δ>0 and axiomatic properties at least as strong as the cited Wightman/Osterwalder–Schrader schemes. Here a mass gap means that for the reconstructed Hamiltonian H with vacuum energy 0 and spectrum in [0,∞), some Δ>0 has σ(H)∩(0,Δ)=∅, with finite supremal gap as specified by the official problem statement.

source.title: Jaffe and Witten, Quantum Yang–Mills Theory, official Clay problem description
source.read: PDF pp.5–7: problem statement and mass-gap definition; constructive-QFT discussion of uniform estimates, finite-volume limits and continuum existence.
source.current_status_source: Clay Mathematics Institute, Yang-Mills & the Mass Gap
source.current_status_read: Lines 67–75 state that no proof of the mass-gap property is known; checked 2026-10-12.

entries.scope_note: This record does not promote finite lattice identities, formal perturbative coefficients, simulations, or finite-regulator spectral results to a continuum construction.

qed_scope_note: No continuum four-dimensional interacting QED construction is supplied by this QFT dossier. This is recorded as a local scope hold, not as a separately sourced open-problem record or a proof of nonexistence.
